title: French Empanadas with Comte Cheese
description: A French twist on the traditional Uruguayan empanadas. These empanadas are filled with Comte cheese and baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Comte cheese
ingredients.notes: High-quality Comte cheese is essential for this recipe

ingredients.name: Empanada dough (homemade or store-bought)
ingredients.notes: You can use either homemade or store-bought empanada dough

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use flaky sea salt for added flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use fresh black pepper for added flavor

ingredients.name: Egg wash
ingredients.notes: For brushing the empanadas with egg wash before baking

ingredients.name: Butter, melted
ingredients.notes: For brushing the empanadas with melted butter before baking

instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of Comte cheese in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with melted butter.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the empanadas for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
